newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jinro Group targets 10.1 trln won sales in 2000.
newsitem.headline: Jinro Group targets 10.1 trln won sales in 2000.

text.p: South Korea's Jinro Group said on Monday it targeted sales of 10.1 trillion won in 2000 by its affiliates from this year's target of 3.5 trillion won.
Jinro's flagship unit is Jinro Ltd, South Korea's biggest liquor maker, and has 13 more affiliates.
A Jinro statement said it would strengthen its operations in the manufacturing of raw materials for semiconductors and the telecommunications services to attain the sharp sales growth.
The statement said the ratio of liquor and beverages in its overall sales would fall to 20 percent in 2000 from this year's 47 percent.
Jinro has also targeted a further increase in sales to 22.8 trillion won by 2005 and to 38 trillion by 2010, the statement said.
